evals.prompt: I'm about to force-push develop in services/billing. Before that, ask the sessions on my other machines whether anyone is writing to that repo — only the ones that could be affected.
evals.expected_output: Runs `ccm roster`, picks members whose task or cwd relates to billing, @s only them via SendMessage with a self-contained first line; does not broadcast to everyone.

evals.prompt: Tell every session that the shared LLM gateway restarts in 10 minutes and calls will fail meanwhile.
evals.expected_output: Uses `ccm broadcast` once with a clear self-contained message; does not loop SendMessage per member.

evals.prompt: I just got a new Linux box, ssh alias `box1`. Hook it into the Claude group chat.
evals.expected_output: Checks key-based ssh, runs `ccm pair box1 --remote-label box1` from the hub, then `ccm doctor`; reports the result.
